title: The Lord of Pain — Rakdos Poisoned-Gift Group Slug
subtitle: Bracket 4 · 6 Game Changers · Exquisite Blood + Sanguine Bond loop · 100 cards · built 2026-08-23, lifegain pass same day · Bracket 3 variant = 4 swaps (see swap page)
stats: 34 (33 tap for mana; 10 basic incl. 4 fetches, 3 MDFC)
42 (34 lands + 8 rocks; 41 actually tap — Glacial Chasm doesn't)
footer: Every amplifier is opponent-only on purpose: the gift engines are symmetric, so a Fiery Emancipation would triple Spiteful Visions' pings on YOU. Your own damage comes back: Basilisk Collar/Whip of Erebos lifelink on the pingers, Glacial Chasm prevents all damage to you. One opponent draw under Solphim + Torture Pit with six punishers = 27. Replacement ordering is the damaged player's choice (CR 616.1): (1×2)+2+2 = 6, never (1+4)×2. Full math in research/formulas.md, pilot notes in research/gameplan.md.

in.name: Shadowspear
in.text: Equipped creature gets +1/+1, trample, lifelink. {1}: opponents' permanents lose hexproof and indestructible. Equip {2}.

out.name: Sanguine Bond
out.text: Whenever you gain life, target opponent loses that much life.

swaps.why: BRACKET 3 SWAP. Bond + Exquisite Blood (or + Bloodthirsty Conqueror) is a two-card infinite; taking Bond out removes both loops. Shadowspear is a second lifelink equipment for the commander.

in.name: Imp's Mischief
in.text: Change the target of target spell with a single target. You lose life equal to that spell's mana value.

out.name: Vampiric Tutor
out.text: Search your library for a card and put it on top. Lose 2 life.

swaps.why: BRACKET 3 SWAP. Game Changer, and B3 wants tutors sparse. The redirect behind Deflecting Swat.

in.name: Leechridden Swamp
in.text: Swamp; enters tapped. {B},{T}: each opponent loses 1 life (needs two black permanents).

out.name: Glacial Chasm
out.text: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you. Cumulative upkeep — pay 2 life. Sacrifice a land on entry; creatures you control can't attack; no mana.

swaps.why: BRACKET 3 SWAP. Glacial Chasm is on the Game Changers list.

out.name: Mana Vault
out.text: Doesn't untap during your untap step. At the beginning of your upkeep, you may pay {4} to untap it. At the beginning of your draw step, if tapped, it deals 1 damage to you. {T}: Add {C}{C}{C}.

in.name: Mind Stone
in.text: {T}: Add {C}. {1}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.

swaps.why: BRACKET 3 SWAP. Game Changer. Mind Stone is the non-GC 2-drop that cashes in for a card late.

out.name: Grim Monolith
out.text: Doesn't untap during your untap step. {T}: Add {C}{C}{C}. {4}: Untap this artifact.

in.name: Basalt Monolith
in.text: Doesn't untap during your untap step. {T}: Add {C}{C}{C}. {3}: Untap this artifact.

swaps.why: BRACKET 3 SWAP. Game Changer. Basalt is the same card one mana up, with a {3} untap instead of {4}.

out.name: Mox Diamond
out.text: If this would enter, you may discard a land card instead. If you do, put it onto the battlefield. If you don't, put it into its owner's graveyard. {T}: Add one mana of any color.

in.name: Thought Vessel
in.text: You have no maximum hand size. {T}: Add {C}.

swaps.why: BRACKET 3 SWAP. Game Changer. Vessel is a second no-max-hand-size effect behind Reliquary Tower, which matters at 6+ draws a turn.

sideboard.name: Teferi's Puzzle Box
sideboard.when: Chaos-friendly, counter-light tables — hand+3 punished draws per player per turn; you can't hold answers past your draw step. Displaces No Mercy.

sideboard.name: Shadowspear
sideboard.when: Second lifelink equipment for the commander (already the B3 Sanguine swap). Displaces No Mercy.

sideboard.name: Bloodchief Ascension
sideboard.when: Grindy pod — arms in 3 end steps, then 2 per card into their graveyard (14 per wheel). Displaces Seizan.

sideboard.name: Burning Inquiry
sideboard.when: 1-mana wheel-lite: 3 draws × punishers per opponent. Displaces Fraying Omnipotence.

sideboard.name: Leechridden Swamp
sideboard.when: B3 tables (Glacial Chasm is a Game Changer), or when the 35th land must tap for mana. Displaces Glacial Chasm.

sideboard.name: Lightning Greaves
sideboard.when: You need haste+shroud more than self-targeting (Coat attach, Collar equip, Witch's Clinic). Displaces Swiftfoot Boots.

sideboard.name: Imp's Mischief
sideboard.when: Combo/counter-heavy pod — second redirect, spells only, costs life = MV (already the B3 Vampiric swap). Displaces Vial Smasher.

sideboard.name: Brash Taunter
sideboard.when: Creature-heavy pod — Taunter + Blasphemous Act is 13 (×2 Solphim) to one player. Displaces Fraying Omnipotence.

sideboard.name: Kardur, Doomscourge
sideboard.when: Go-wide attackers; goad + drain. Displaces No Mercy.

sideboard.name: Mindcrank
sideboard.when: B4 only — infinite with Bloodchief Ascension (bring both) at 3 counters. Displaces Fraying Omnipotence + Seizan.

sideboard.name: Wheel of Misfortune
sideboard.when: A second true wheel. Displaces Fraying Omnipotence.

sideboard.name: Stormfist Crusader
sideboard.when: Low-curve pod; 2-drop gift/ping. Displaces Seizan.

sideboard.name: Master of the Feast
sideboard.when: Pure 'here, have a card' 5/5 flier. Displaces Dark Ritual.

sideboard.name: Court of Ambition
sideboard.when: Grindy pod; 3 life or discard per upkeep, monarch baits attacks away. Displaces Manabarbs.

sideboard.name: Wild Evocation
sideboard.when: Chaos table — forced free cast each upkeep triggers Lord/Kaervek/Quandary. Displaces Seizan.

sideboard.name: Repercussion
sideboard.when: Opponents creature-heavy, you are not: Blasphemous Act = 13 × their creatures to each of them. Displaces Fraying Omnipotence.

sideboard.name: Ob Nixilis, the Hate-Twisted
sideboard.when: 8th draw-punisher that is also removal. Displaces Manabarbs.

sideboard.name: Archfiend of Despair
sideboard.when: Second Wound Reflection for long Coffers games. Displaces Wound Reflection or runs alongside.

sideboard.name: Kefka, Dancing Mad
sideboard.when: 'I cast your cards and you pay for them' finisher. Displaces Heartless Hidetsugu.

sideboard.name: Chandra, Awakened Inferno
sideboard.when: Enchantment-removal-heavy pod; emblems can't be answered. Displaces Manabarbs.

sideboard.name: Withering Torment
sideboard.when: Extra enchantment answer (Leyline of Sanctity blanks the commander). Displaces Feed the Swarm.

sideboard.name: Tempting Contract
sideboard.when: You want the Treasure gift back (bigger opposing spells → bigger Lord/Kaervek hits). Displaces Rakdos, Lord of Riots.

sideboard.name: Bolt Bend
sideboard.when: Third redirect behind Deflecting Swat; costs {R} with the commander out. Single-target spells only. Displaces Mox Diamond.

sideboard.name: Mana Flare
sideboard.when: Table where the extra mana poisons them more than it helps them. It gives three opponents what it gives you. Displaces Dark Ritual.

sideboard.name: Bojuka Bog
sideboard.when: Reanimator pod — a second graveyard exile behind Rakdos Charm. Enters tapped. Displaces Mana Vault.

sideboard.name: Scrawling Crawler
sideboard.when: Grindy pod with no amplifier in sight — its 1 life per opponent draw is life loss, which Solphim/Torbran/Torture Pit cannot multiply, so its value collapses exactly when the deck is winning. Displaces Grim Monolith.
